title: BLEACH: TYBW Part 4 (Final Season) Reveals New Trailer
content: The final season of BLEACH: TYBW Part 4, titled Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Final Part – The Calamity , revealed a new trailer on Tuesday. The series will debut in U.S. theaters from June 25 to June 29. It will then start broadcasting on Japanese TV in July 2026.
author: Anime Corner

title: Cyborg 009: Nemesis Anime Casts Yuu Hayashi as Cyborg 008
content: The staff of Ishimori Production 's Cyborg 009: Nemesis , a new anime based on Shōtarō Ishinomori 's Cyborg 009 manga, announced on Tuesday that Yuu Hayashi is joining the anime's cast as Cyborg 008/Pyunma. Yūki Kaji plays the anime's main character Joe Shimamura.
author: ANN

title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity Anime Presents Main Trailer
content: The staff for Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity , the fourth and final part of the Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War anime, presented the anime's main trailer on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: 3rd Mononoke Film Streams Special Trailer
content: Twin Engine revealed on Tuesday a special trailer for Gekijōban Mononoke Dai-San-Shō: Hebigami ( Mononoke the Movie: Chapter 3: Snake God ), the third installment of the Mononoke franchise 's film trilogy .
